Messages.Author: Metropolis
Messages.Body:
Players order:

A - B - C - D - E ->A

A vampire controlled by Player C blocks a vampire controlled by Player D
coming from torpor and diablerises him. The bloodhunt to burn C is
successful, but E & B want to play Redline, who gets to first? what if they
announce their desire simultaneously?

What if a vampire controlled by Player C simply wishes to diablerize and is
then burned? who can play redline first?

I realize this issue has existed before with many cards, but I just realized
I don't really know how to answer it.
